def transform2(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    C=comps(g)
    noise=set()
    for col,cs in C.items():
        if max(len(c) for c in cs)<=2:
            for c in cs: noise.update(c)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    def rect_score(r,c,col):
        best=None
        for r1 in range(0,r+1):
            for r2 in range(r,H):
                cl=c
                while cl-1>=0 and all(g[x][cl-1]==col or (x,cl-1) in noise for x in range(r1,r2+1)): cl-=1
                cr=c
                while cr+1<W and all(g[x][cr+1]==col or (x,cr+1) in noise for x in range(r1,r2+1)): cr+=1
                cells=[(x,y) for x in range(r1,r2+1) for y in range(cl,cr+1)]
                if not all(g[x][y]==col or (x,y) in noise for x,y in cells): continue
                nactual=sum(1 for x,y in cells if g[x][y]==col)
                if nactual<2: continue
                up = r1==0 or not all(g[r1-1][y]==col or (r1-1,y) in noise for y in range(cl,cr+1))
                dn = r2==H-1 or not all(g[r2+1][y]==col or (r2+1,y) in noise for y in range(cl,cr+1))
                lf = cl==0 or not all(g[x][cl-1]==col or (x,cl-1) in noise for x in range(r1,r2+1))
                rt = cr==W-1 or not all(g[x][cr+1]==col or (x,cr+1) in noise for x in range(r1,r2+1))
                if not (up and dn and lf and rt): continue
                sc=(min(r2-r1+1,cr-cl+1),(r2-r1+1)*(cr-cl+1))
                if best is None or sc>best: best=sc
        return best
    for (r,c) in sorted(noise):
        cnt=collections.Counter()
        for x,y in((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
            if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and (x,y) not in noise: cnt[g[x][y]]+=1
        if not cnt: continue
        mx=max(cnt.values()); cand=[k for k,v in cnt.items() if v==mx]
        newc=cand[0]
        if len(cand)>1:
            best=None
            for col in cand:
                s=rect_score(r,c,col)
                if s and (best is None or s>best[0]): best=(s,col)
            if best: newc=best[1]
        out[r][c]=newc
    return out
